risk_summary: The excerpt is generally transparent and includes useful segment, trend, and cash-flow disclosures, although much of the introductory language is standard MD&A boilerplate. Risk is centered on cyclical semiconductor and display demand, declining memory and display spending, customer concentration, technology transitions, and dependence on timely product development. Overall tone is cautiously positive, balancing strong fiscal 2018 performance and long-term growth opportunities against expected near-term softness.
